question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"on".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence ***"The radio was already on. The radio comes(1) _______ automatically at 7 o'clock to wake me***(2) _________. ***" ****is talking ***about the radio, which was already on and it starts working by being switched on automatically at 7 o'clock.**
 
• Also, the use of the word '**already on**' in the beginning sentence indicates the use of the word '**on**' in the blank.
 
• **Comes on (Phrasal verb): means **develop or progress; start working by being switched on; appear on a stage.
 
 
• ***Example***: *She preset the cooker to **come on** at 6.30.*
 
 
 
• *​*With the given **example** and the **meaning** of the phrasal verb, it's clear that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is** "on".**
 
• The correct answer is **option 3.**

**Complete Passage: ***The radio was already on. The radio comes **on** automatically at 7 o'clock to wake me (2) _________. I looked at the clock. (3) _______ was already ten past seven. I had to get up quickly. I went into the shower, and I could (4) _______ the news on the radio. I couldn't hear it very well, but there was a story on the news about an elephant that had (5) ________ from a local circus.*
